name: Vaporwave
oneLiner: A sunset grid horizon, chrome type, and pastel neon: the internet's romantic memory of the 1980s, rendered on purpose.

effects.noise: 4% grain over the horizon gradient to stop banding
effects.horizon-grid: repeating-linear-gradient at 1px / 24px both axes, masked to fade below the fold

motion.reducedMotion: static horizon; keep the gradient and remove the grid scroll and shimmer

primary.base: height: 46px; padding: 0 26px; border: 1px solid #FF71CE; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 113, 206, 0.12); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-family: Michroma, Eurostile, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; backdrop-filter: blur(6px)

chrome.base: height: 46px; padding: 0 26px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #C9C9E8 45%, #7A7AA8 55%, #F0F0FF 100%); color: #1A0E2E; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase

default.base: padding: 24px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(29, 18, 51, 0.82); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); backdrop-filter: blur(6px)
position: relative; min-height: 320px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2A1046 0%, #6B1E63 55%, #FF71CE 100%); overflow: hidden
default.sun: position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 34%; width: 160px; height: 160px; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFD166 0%, #FF71CE 100%); filter: blur(0.5px); transform: translateX(-50%)
default.grid: position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0; height: 45%; background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(1, 205, 254, 0.55) 0 1px, transparent 1px 40px), repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(1, 205, 254, 0.55) 0 1px, transparent 1px 32px); transform: perspective(320px) rotateX(62deg); transform-origin: bottom

default.base: font-family: Michroma, Eurostile, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem); letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #F3E9FF; text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 113, 206, 0.7), 0 0 32px rgba(1, 205, 254, 0.45)
default.chrome: background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #C9C9E8 45%, #7A7AA8 55%, #F0F0FF 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; text-shadow: none

default.base: height: 46px; width: 100%; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(18, 10, 32, 0.7); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.9375rem

do: Anchor the page with one horizon scene: sun disc, grid floor, gradient sky — then keep content surfaces calm.
Use chrome or glow on headlines only, never on body copy.
Keep the neon pair (pink and cyan) to two hues and one gradient.
Set body copy in a clean sans; the retro faces are for display and small labels.
dont: Do not apply chrome text effects to paragraphs or form labels.
Do not animate the grid continuously at full contrast; mask it and slow it down.
Do not use VT323 for body copy below 16px.
Do not stack three neon hues plus a chrome gradient in one view.
antiPatterns: Full-page grid animation behind a checkout form.
Chrome gradient applied to every heading and button, so nothing has hierarchy.
Vaporwave colors used with corporate photography and stock people — the register collapses.

notes: Glow and chrome reduce effective contrast; never put body text in either treatment.
Pink #FF71CE on near-black is above 4.5:1, but on the mid-gradient purple it fails; keep text on the card surface.
Perspective grid and parallax trigger vestibular issues; disable both under prefers-reduced-motion.
